system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "AI cognitive harm immediate quantification",
    "detail": "Presenting short-term study results on AI use as demonstrating rapid measurable intellectual damage. Also: Already in existing biases list - should not be duplicated.",
    "debias": "Report AI impact studies with appropriate caveats about study design, duration, and generalizability of findings. N/A",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Using AI for basic tasks damages a person's intellect in just 10 minutes, study shows",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/next/2026/04/16/using-ai-for-basic-tasks-damages-a-persons-intellect-in-just-10-minutes-study-shows",
    "unbiased_text": "A study found participants using AI for basic tasks performed worse on subsequent tests than those who did not use AI"
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Litigation guilt institutional presumption",
    "detail": "Treating court guilty verdicts of corporations as vindication of broader systemic accusations without noting legal nuances.",
    "debias": "Report verdicts accurately while distinguishing between specific charges and broader claims about corporate behavior.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "​A Paris court ​on Monday found cement maker Lafarge, now owned by Switzerland's Holcim, guilty ​of ‌paying the Islamic State group and other jihadists to ⁠keep a plant operating in northern Syria ​during the country's ‌civil war.",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20260413-french-cement-maker-lafarge-found-guilty-of-financing-jihadists-in-syria",
    "unbiased_text": "A Paris court found cement maker Lafarge guilty of making payments that benefited the Islamic State group and other armed groups to maintain operations at a plant in northern Syria during the civil war."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Resource depletion deadline sensationalism",
    "detail": "Presenting finite timeframes for resource exhaustion as crisis countdowns without context about mitigation efforts or alternatives.",
    "debias": "Include information about contingency planning, alternative sources, and industry responses alongside shortage timelines.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Europe has six weeks of jet fuel left caused by 'dire strait' crisis, IEA chief warns",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/16/europe-has-six-weeks-of-jet-fuel-left-caused-by-dire-strait-crisis-iea-chief-warns",
    "unbiased_text": "IEA chief warns Europe faces potential jet fuel shortages within six weeks if Strait of Hormuz disruptions continue, though industry is exploring alternative supply routes and conservation measures."
  }
]
